title: Legal status table for one substance (monograph section 13)
description: Date-stamped scheduling by jurisdiction, each row tied to the primary legal text or the official consolidated list. Facts, not claims: no GRADE. Rows stay 'draft' until the senior author has checked them; legal interpretation is out of scope.

status.description: The schedule/class/table as the instrument names it, in plain words.

instrument.description: The law, regulation or list, with its number and date as officially cited.

medical_use.description: Whether a medicinal product containing the substance is authorized there, if the source says.

source_date.description: Date or version of the consolidated text or list consulted.

checked_by.description: For an ai-checked row: the second reader and how they checked (METHODS §10.3).
